about.title: About APSTPM
about.subtitle: Promoting Science and Technology Practice, Serving Macau
about.missionDescription: APSTPM is a non-profit organization. Our mission is to research and assist in promoting awareness of science and technology practice in Macau, enhance the use of technology in education and outreach, support the development of our members, and serve the community.
about.historyDescription: Professionals engaged in science and technology related research, management, technical, and education fields who are willing to abide by the association's bylaws may apply for membership by submitting an application form and paying the membership fee, subject to approval by the Board of Directors.
